title: Event bundle forward-gated trade adapter parity
hypothesis: The strongest current alpha direction is event candidate-pool allocation, specifically the non-generic positive state-surface event add-on from exp-20260509-007. Before this alpha can move from default-off paper attribution toward live capital, it needs a shared forward-gated trade adapter so production and historical replay cannot diverge.

alpha_hypothesis.selected_direction: default-off event overlay bundle with non-generic positive state-surface add-on
alpha_hypothesis.why_this_now: Recent records show LLM soft-ranking is data-limited, earnings/revision alpha remains blocked by field coverage, core threshold/ranking retunes are mostly rejected or below materiality, and event candidate allocation is the only recent surface with all three canonical windows improving.

accepted_or_promising_parent.exp-20260509-006: Frozen current-stack event bundle improved EV in all three fixed windows versus accepted core.
accepted_or_promising_parent.exp-20260509-007: Non-generic positive state-surface add-on beat the full event bundle in all three fixed windows.

nearby_rejected_or_blocked.LLM soft-ranking: Production-aligned soft-ranking outcomes remain too sparse.
nearby_rejected_or_blocked.earnings/revisions: Multi-window earnings/revision candidate coverage remains insufficient.
nearby_rejected_or_blocked.generic add-on heat reserve: Rejected or inert; raw heat relaxation is production-unsafe.

historical_experiment_check.mechanism_insight_conflict: No conflict. This run did not retry a rejected threshold/filter/source subset. It kept the accepted alpha surface and removed the promotion parity blocker.

gate_4_result.decision_basis: No default strategy metrics moved because the adapter is blocked by default. The positive alpha evidence is the existing exp-20260509-007 paper-allocation result; this run closes the shared adapter requirement for future promotion.

production_impact.promotion_blocker_remaining: Closed forward paper replacement-value outcomes must pass the shared gate before trade_enabled can be set true.

decision_rationale: Keep event candidate allocation as the current strongest alpha direction, but do not enable live orders. The adapter now creates a single shared action surface that stays blocked unless trade_enabled is explicit, the forward paper gate passes, the kill switch is clear, and candidate schema is valid.
why_not_other_attractive_points: Skipped LLM soft-ranking, earnings/revisions, raw universe expansion, generic heat reserve, clean mid-dispersion top-up, and event source pruning because recent experiment records mark them data-limited, rejected, production-unsafe, or below materiality.
risk_of_change: The main risk is future misuse: manually enabling trade_enabled without enough closed forward event outcomes would promote a sparse paper edge too early. The adapter therefore keeps forward gate and kill-switch blocks in the shared helper.
